title: Tiny, cute magic wand
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="wandGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFA500"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="glowGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF8DC" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#FFD700" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFD700" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="starGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#FFFACD" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFD700" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sparkle glow behind star -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="22" r="16" fill="url(#starGlow)"/>

  <!-- Wand stick -->
  <line x1="26" y1="78" x2="64" y2="32" stroke="#C86400" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="26" y1="78" x2="64" y2="32" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Wand handle grip -->
  <line x1="22" y1="84" x2="30" y2="74" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="84" x2="30" y2="74" stroke="#D2691E" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Star at tip -->
  <polygon points="72,10 75.5,17.5 84,18.5 77.5,24 79.5,32.5 72,28 64.5,32.5 66.5,24 60,18.5 68.5,17.5"
           fill="#FFD700" stroke="#FFEC8B" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- Inner star highlight -->
  <polygon points="72,14 74,19 78.5,19.5 75,23 76.5,27.5 72,24.5 67.5,27.5 69,23 65.5,19.5 70,19"
           fill="#FFFACD"/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx="52" cy="20" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="38" r="1.3" fill="#FFFACD"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="58" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#FFFACD"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Small cross sparkles -->
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="48" y1="28" x2="48" y2="32"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="30" x2="50" y2="30"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#FFFACD" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="82" y1="12" x2="82" y2="16"/>
    <line x1="80" y1="14" x2="84" y2="14"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="90" y1="50" x2="90" y2="53"/>
    <line x1="88.5" y1="51.5" x2="91.5" y2="51.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny trail dots -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="66" r="1.2" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="1.3" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="29" cy="74" r="1" fill="#FFD700" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
